race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: A case can be made for most of these, but preference is for SAVVY DISKO , who suffered an unpleasant fall at Glorious Goodwood when bidding for a hat-trick but got back on track at Yarmouth a couple of months ago. He can make a winning start on all-weather at the expense of Stoneacre Donny , who was edged out by a course specialist over C&D recently. Water To Wine can edge out Paddy The Squire for third. SAVVY DISKO (IRE) STONEACRE DONNY WATER TO WINE (FR)
